title: Canine CCL Rupture & TPLO Surgery
complaint: Acute non-weight bearing lameness on left hind leg following vigorous ball fetch.
treatment: Performed Tibial Plateau Leveling Osteotomy (TPLO) using 3.5mm locking compression plate.
outcome: Full functional weight-bearing restored. Radiographic bone union confirmed.

title: Feline Chronic Kidney Disease (Stage II)
complaint: Polyuria, polydipsia, weight loss, and reduced grooming over 2 months.
treatment: Prescription renal diet, Telmisartan for hypertension, and daily Omega-3 EPA/DHA.
outcome: Blood pressure stabilized. Creatinine improved to Stage I-II transition baseline.

title: Severe Atopic Dermatitis & Cytopoint mAb
complaint: Chronic pruritus, pedal lick granulomas, and ventral abdominal erythema.
treatment: Lokivetmab (Cytopoint) mAb injection + chlorhexidine medicated baths 2x weekly.
outcome: Pruritus reduced within 24 hours. Skin barrier restored at 4-week followup.
